# Amirali Gholian

Official website and technical portfolio of Amirali Gholian.

## About

This website provides educational resources, technical documentation, and personal projects focused on programming, Python, Linux, networking, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. The content is designed for students, developers, and technology enthusiasts.

## Topics

- Python Programming
- Linux
- Networking
- Network Security
- Cybersecurity
- Artificial Intelligence
- Machine Learning
- NumPy
- Pandas
- Scikit-learn
- Web Development
- Technical Documentation
- Personal Portfolio

## Website Purpose

The website serves as a personal technical knowledge base and portfolio, offering tutorials, code examples, documentation, and educational content related to modern software development and computer science.
